items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure and canonical volume, including rank zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C2, 0<α≤β, and α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for all x,v. Let η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ=volume.tilted(−V), J=law(X,X+√ηZ) for independent X∼μ and Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and S_y=volume.tilted(u↦−V((y+u)/2)−‖y−u‖²/(8η)). Then ν is a probability and there is one dense closable compact-gradient operator G:L²(ν;ℝ)⇀L²(ν;E), chosen before f, with closed closure and exact graph consisting of the pairs represented by φ and ∇φ for φ∈C∞_c(E). For every signed f∈C∞_c(E), let Tf(y)=∫f(u)S_y(du). Both Tf and ∇Tf belong to L²(ν), and their canonical classes satisfy ([Tf],[∇Tf])∈graph(closure G). No compact support of Tf or caller normalization, regularity, Lp or closure certificate is assumed. This is attributed analytic integration of the compact source branch, not the full rough B.13 statement.
assumptions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel E and canonical volume; rank zero is an explicit background extension of the source Euclidean presentation.
V is C2; α,β are nonnegative, α>0, α≤β and both global directional Hessian bounds hold. η>0 and βη≤1.
Every observer is signed smooth compact f; neither centering nor compact support of its mean Tf is required.

All laws and the mean are the literal displayed ones. G is constructed uniformly before all f; its entire smooth compact AE graph is characterized. Probability, Lp, C1 and graph membership are produced internally.
